items.question: What is the minimum order for B2B pricing?
items.answer: B2B discounts start from 5 units. Orders of 1–4 units are fulfilled at standard retail pricing.

items.question: Can I mix different products in one bulk order?
items.answer: Yes. Your total quantity across all products determines your tier discount.

items.question: How long does it take to receive a quote?
items.answer: Our team responds to all B2B inquiries within 24 business hours.

items.question: Are there payment terms available for large orders?
items.answer: Yes, we offer net-30 and net-60 payment terms for verified businesses with orders over 20 units.

items.question: Do bulk orders come with a warranty?
items.answer: All products carry their standard manufacturer warranty. Extended coverage is available as an add-on.
